blocks.text: LIGAO CITY — Households and businesses in parts of Albay’s third district are expected to experience fewer power outages and benefit from the upgrading of the Albay Electric Cooperative Inc. (ALECO) substation in this city. The upgraded facility in Barangay Dunao was unveiled on Wednesday, with a doubled installed capacity of 40 megavolt-amperes (MVA) from 20 MVA. ALECO Technical Services Department Manager Engr. Mark Jessan Lucilo said the expansion is expected to ease pressure on existing electrical facilities, improve load distribution and address low-voltage problems and recurring power interruptions. “The cooperative is committed to improving its technical operations, load management and […]...
